title.fr: Superposition de champs électriques (deux charges ponctuelles)

sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with two source charges q₁, q₂ (draggable, ±
toggle, magnitude sliders) and a draggable test point M. Canvas2D
overlay draws E₁ and E₂ as separate colored arrows at M plus the
resultant E = E₁ + E₂ as a bold arrow (vector sum shown graphically
head-to-tail). HUD: |E₁|, |E₂|, |E|, angle of E. Experiment: hit a
target resultant direction at M (e.g., horizontal E) by placing
charges symmetrically. Evaluate: E arrows hidden; a target arrow
silhouette shown at M — student picks charge positions/signs so
their (hidden) resultant matches. Wrinkle: vector addition is
graphical, no coordinates required.
